text:
[LTAC.6.1.1] An `after` clause may appear at the rule top level
alongside `on`, `timeout`, or `error` clauses on a `call` action.
The clauses target different events: `on` / `timeout` / `error`
fire on call response state per [LCCO]; `after` fires on
a monotonic-clock delay ([LTIM.2.8.2]) regardless of any call's state. The compiler
must lower each clause independently per its own §3 / [LCCO.3].
